releases.notes:
# 1.4.20: Code-review overhaul; TreeHarvester 10.x support (#31); FTB Ultimine support; per-player preference files

Fixed
- TreeHarvester 10.x crashed on block break (#31): logs and leaves are
  credited again and saplings are replanted per tree type. 9.x is still
  supported, and the drop hooks are optional so a future change cannot
  crash the game.
- Drop contexts leaked when hooked methods returned early or threw:
  Level.destroyBlock and FallingTree's falling-block tick now close at
  RETURN, the shear hook closes what it opened, TreeHarvester hooks use
  try/finally, 1.21.1 brushing closes at RETURN, and a tick-end safety
  net clears anything left open.
- Players without the mod got mob XP pickup by default; a player's own
  preference now only counts once it is set, else the server value.
- Non-ops editing themselves wrote admin overrides that outlived the
  allow_* flags; they now set their own preference.
- 1.21.0-1 was missing the on-stack drop fallback.
- Nested compat scopes lost their player (blockBreaker is now a stack).
- /autopickup global printed success for unknown or mis-cased keys and
  saved nothing; keys are now case-insensitive and unknown keys fail.
- Malformed config JSON crashed startup; the bad file is now backed up
  and defaults are used.
- Block XP was lost if a toggle flipped or the player left within the
  2-tick Mending delay.
- Split with zero participants threw ArithmeticException.
- FallingTree leaf drops: hook the public forceBreakDecayLeaves instead
  of a synthetic lambda whose parameters did not match on 1.20.1.
- 1.16.5 Forge dev client launched on Java 21 and crashed.

Added
- FTB Ultimine support: it breaks blocks through the player's own break
  path, so ultimined blocks, merged drops and right-click crop harvests
  are collected with no dedicated code (1.20.1 to 26.1.2).
- /autopickup shows each player the value that applies to them and its
  source (admin override, your setting, server default); the server
  column reads CLIENT DECIDE (default: ON/OFF). The console sees the
  server column only.
- Players' own preferences are saved one file per player,
  preferences/<uuid>.json (worlds/<world>/preferences/ in singleplayer),
  whether set by command or synced by the client. Loaded on first use,
  written atomically only on change. A client sync that replaces a
  stored value tells the player.
- Pickup handler registry in AutoPickupApi; Traveler's Backpack and
  TreeHarvester register at init instead of mixing into AutoPickupApi.
- CI fetches the optional-mod jars from Modrinth and Maven by SHA-1
  (gradle/compat-libs.json, ./gradlew fetchLibs) and builds every
  version with --continue.
- JUnit tests for core/ (59), including tests that lock the config file
  and wire formats.
- ./gradlew driftCheck lists files identical across version folders.

Changed
- The seven settings are one Toggle enum; config files, the sync
  bitmask, command keys and the client file are unchanged.
- One home for defaults; logic for directly spawned items moved into a
  shared ItemSpawnHook; shared ClientSession for loader clients, which
  only sync with servers that have the mod.
- TreeHarvester natamus/serilum mixin pairs merged; leaf ownership kept
  in a tick-expired side map instead of a BlockPos subclass; the
  serilum modules compile against TreeHarvester 10.3.
- Packages unified to com.lukarbonite.autopickup (1.16.5, 1.20.1,
  1.21.0-1); files identical in 26.1 to 26.3 moved to shared/26+;
  per-version build boilerplate moved to a buildSrc convention plugin.
- Java sources normalized to LF (.gitattributes).
- README commands, defaults and compatibility list match the code; CI
  installs JDK 8, 17, 21 and 25 and uploads every loader jar.

Removed
- Dead code: no-op AutoPickupMixinPlugin, FLAG_ALLOW_CLIENT, unused
  FLAG_* re-exports and tryPickupBlockExperience, unused locals.

Fixes #31
- Fixed: Mod-spawned death drops (e.g. Butchery carcasses) and leads on leashed mobs not auto-picked up (#29 ); 1.12.2: horse/donkey/llama inventory and pig saddles now picked up on player kills
- Fixed: Block XP lost on NeoForge 1.21.1 (ores dropped no XP with autopickup) #27

**AutoPickup 1.4.17**

**Fixed**
- The game no longer crashes after breaking blocks with TreeHarvester 9.5 installed (#26). TreeHarvester 9.5 moved its code to a new package, which broke AutoPickup's TreeHarvester support.

**Added**
- Support for TreeHarvester 9.5 on 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 26.2 and 26.3. Versions 9.4 and older keep working as before.

**Changed**
- On 1.21.9 to 1.21.11 and 26.1, the TreeHarvester support switches itself off if a TreeHarvester update moves to the new package, instead of crashing.

### Added
- **26.3 support** (Fabric and NeoForge).
- **1.16.5 support** (Fabric and Forge). 1.16.5 uses the built-in config screen because YACL isn't available for this version.
- **1.12.2 support** (Forge 14.23.5.2864). **Requires MixinBooter 11 or newer.** It has the same commands, per-server client profiles, master keybind and three-tab config screen as the other versions (open it from the Mods list or with `/autopickup gui`).

### Fixed
- **Forge/NeoForge clients now sync on dedicated servers.** On Forge 1.20.1 and 1.21.0-1, and NeoForge 1.21.0-1 through 26.2, joining a dedicated server never sent your client profile or loaded the server's admin state and global config. LAN hosts also re-synced every time a guest joined. Both are fixed.
- **NeoForge client profiles now switch per server.** On NeoForge 1.21.9 through 26.2, players were always on `client_default.toml`. The profile now switches when you join and leave a server, like on every other loader.
- **Fabric crash on older Fabric Loader versions.** Builds made with Loader 0.19.5 crashed at startup on older Loaders with a `ClassCastException`. They now load on both. Behavior is unchanged.

### Changed
- On 26.1 and 26.2, YACL is now pinned to 3.9.6 for each loader. This replaces the temporary Fabric build that both loaders were using.
- Internally, the logic that doesn't depend on Minecraft now lives in one module that every version shares. Settings, commands and loot splitting should now behave the same on every version.
- Added: Brushable block and brush entity compatibility.

- Supports all of 1.20.x
- Command Tunneling: The client now syncs settings using a chat-hidden command (/ap_config_sync) which is compatible on most or all versions making it cross compatible with other Minecraft versions on 1.3.1

- Config file and commands instead of gamerules. Mod Menu support
- AllowClientControl configuration

###  Features

*   **New Experience Gamerule:** Added a new gamerule, `autoPickupXp`, to allow independent control over the automatic pickup of experience orbs. It is enabled by default. This gives users full control over how items and experience are collected.
*  **Mending Compatibility:** The XP that is automatically picked up now goes to one of the items to mended before giving the leftover xp to the xp bar. This is done though a damage first mend later approach using an experience cache system.

###  Technical & API Changes

*   **Unified Experience Cache:** The internal logic for handling experience from both block breaks and mob kills has been refactored into a single, universal caching system. This simplifies the codebase, improves performance, and makes the mod more resilient and future-proof.

readmeSummary: AutoPickup is a highly configurable server-side mod that automates the collection of items and experience orbs.
